correctness.rationale: Formula (1) was reconstructed from Edholm–Mathew (3.21), and reciprocity checked directly. Affine block endpoints and sums of quadratic index polynomials rigorously bound the dependence of each angular coefficient on q by degree three. Exact rational interpolation yields the Fejér factor as both q^2 and q^3 coefficients in each of 84 cases. The included executed program certifies that every dyadically subdivided Bernstein coefficient of both remaining polynomials exceeds 1/200. Nonnegative Bernstein bases and the nonnegative Fejér factor prove the strict inequality for every q>=0 and theta. Reciprocal degree-2k root pairing gives precisely k disk roots; the source proves these imply actual kernel zeros. Computation is a verified finite certificate, not claimed to replace the all-q algebraic degree lemma.

value.rationale: The source poses unit-circle nonvanishing for all coprime generalized Hartogs triangles as a concrete open problem. This work establishes a meaningful complete contiguous finite classification for k=7,...,17, covering infinitely many n at each k and 84 independent reduced residues; it reaches the first case of totient multiplicity sixteen. The common cubic-in-q and Fejér/nonnegative-plus-Bernstein decomposition explains how finite certificates solve infinite-parameter slices. It neither simply renames a known consequence nor infers all k from a finite check. Its limitation to eleven gaps is explicit, but the exact finite cutoff is mathematically motivated by the published classification problem and rapidly increasing residue complexity.
